records.name: SaaS: Sunshine as a Service. ☀️
records.tagline: Stop hoping, start ordering.
records.description: Living in Denmark means constant gray skies. Bestil Solskin is a "Sunshine as a Service" experiment that replaces weather-app anxiety with a simple SMS. How it works: Pick your city and pay 20 DKK. Every day at 18:00, our system scans the APIs. If the clouds part, you get a "delivery" text with your sunshine’s arrival time. It’s the ultimate low-cost dopamine hit for anyone tired of the rain. Order some sun for yourself or a friend.

records.name: Roastify Online
records.tagline: Plug and Play Freelancers Task Management Tool
records.description: Roastify is your all-in-one freelance management platform designed to streamline client relationships, project workflows, and payments. Manage clients and projects in one place, track time accurately, create professional invoices, and get paid faster. Features include task management, time tracking, client management, invoicing, reporting, and team collaboration. Perfect for freelancers, teams, and agencies looking to scale their business efficiently. Built for simplicity and reliability.

records.name: One million smiles
records.tagline: never stop smiling
records.description: One Million Smiles is a long-term digital archive of human smiles. The idea is simple: People from different countries, cultures, and languages upload a smiling photo to one shared space. No algorithms. No filters. No trends. Just real people. The goal is to reach one million smiles and preserve them as a symbol of shared humanity. As the project grows, we’re also exploring future possibilities — including turning this collection into a permanent cultural artifact.

records.name: Veto
records.tagline: Instant AI Legal Document Analysis
records.description: Veto is AI-powered contract analysis for everyone. Upload any legal agreement: NDAs, leases, terms of service, freelance contracts, etc and get plain-English explanations instantly. Ask questions, spot red flags, and finally understand what you're signing. Get recommendations on what and how to negotiate. Built for founders, freelancers, and anyone tired of pretending to read the fine print.
